title: Repeated vibration of Dana RS pump without obvious error
symptom: One DanaRS pump vibrates repeatedly, waking the user, but no error appears in pump history or AAPS history. The only difference is an announcement in AAPS log called 'Blood sugar measurement alert'.
cause: The vibration is caused by a pump alarm generated by the pump itself, related to a Doctor mode setting called Melody option, which was set to 120 by default.
fix: Change the Melody option in Doctor mode to zero to turn off the alert causing the vibration.
evidence_quote: it's related to Doctor mode and Melody option, the factory default for this pump was 120, but needs to be set to zero to turn off the alert which caused the vibration.
